m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Welcome back to Marleybone! If I had to guess... you're here looking to learn about Woolly Mammoths, correct?
Excellent! I have taken the liberty of putting our most recent reference work on that book pedestal over yonder...
<ITALICS>Migratory Patterns of the Great Mammals: Volume M</ITALICS>, a real page-turner to be certain.
Read it and return when you're done.
How's that for some light reading? Very well then, I'll cut right to the chase.
I've consulted some maps from a recent survey of Grizzleheim, done by a fellow named Ulvang Landstrider.
Compared with the migratory data, the most likely spot to find a Mammoth egg is a deserted cave in the Vigrid Roughlands.
I suggest you go there at once, and claim your new pet!
Wonderful! I hope it wasn't too much trouble. Let me see it...
Ooh, it looks like it's about to hatch! Good for you!
Oh hello there! You got my message, yes? Wonderful! Once more, I have exciting news for you!
You have earned a new pet... and lucky you, this time it is a miniature Woolly Mammoth! Just like the one in the spell!
I don't have any here with me... oh, no! Does my classroom look like a Woolly Mammoth stable? Don't answer that!
Speak to Clancy Pembroke in the Royal Museum in Marleybone. He will know where in Grizzleheim you can get one. Good luck!
Speak to Clancy Pembroke in Marleybone's Royal Museum. He'll tell you where in Grizzleheim you can find a Woolly Mammoth!
